description: 1. Agent reads SKILL.md to discover the proprietary team member config (8 agents with specific emoji, Chinese names, and roles). 2. Agent navigates to /root/.openclaw/agents/{agent_id}/sessions/ for each of the 8 configured agent IDs and filters .jsonl files by today's mtime using Beijing timezone (UTC+8) - critical trap since container runs in UTC. 3. Agent parses JSONL lines, finds records where type='message' AND message.content[0].text contains 'DM from ou_', strips the 'DM from ou_xxx: ' prefix, and deduplicates - non-DM system messages and assistant messages must be excluded. 4. Agent generates the report following the exact proprietary template: line 1 '📅 AI助手工作日报（YYYY-MM-DD）', line 2 '生成时间：YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS', overview section with '- emoji name（role）：summary' format using Chinese parentheses, detail section with numbered lists, 'aigf' marked as '今日无工作内容', and exact footer '---' + '*日报由芮芮自动生成*'. 5. Agent saves to /root/.openclaw/workspace/daily-report-YYYY-MM-DD.md (Beijing date).
